# L&M Highways

> A professional surfacing contractor undertaking all aspects of asphalt paving —
> commercial and domestic — based at 46 St Andrews Street, Mildenhall, Suffolk,
> IP28 7HB, and working nationwide across the United Kingdom.

L&M Highways surfaces car parks, access roads, industrial estates, adopted
residential estates, highways and domestic driveways. The company works directly
for businesses, schools, councils and property managers, and alongside main
contractors — including tier 1 contractors — on larger schemes. It also hires out
plant and accredited surfacing crews to other contractors delivering their own
surfacing works.

## Contact

- Registered address: 46 St Andrews Street, Mildenhall, Suffolk, IP28 7HB, United Kingdom
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm
- Coverage: nationwide; local coverage across Suffolk, Norfolk and Cambridgeshire,
  including Bury St Edmunds, Newmarket, Ely, Thetford and Mildenhall

## Accreditations

- Registered with Avetta for main contractor supply chain prequalification
- All employees and operatives hold valid CSCS cards
- Plant operators hold CPCS or NPORS accreditations

## Services

- [Services overview](https://laurenceabbott.github.io/landm/services.html): the full
  range, from commercial surfacing and domestic driveways to highway works,
  groundworks and specialist treatments.
- Commercial surfacing — car parks, access roads, industrial estates, commercial yards.
- Domestic surfacing — tarmac and resin driveways, patios, pathways, private roads.
- Road and highway works — high-speed networks, local towns, residential streets and
  local authority schemes.
- Specialist services — machine lay, hand lay, thermo patching, pre-coat chipping,
  coloured asphalt, road marking, 24/7 emergency response, planning and management.
- [Plant & labour hire](https://laurenceabbott.github.io/landm/services.html#hire):
  rollers, compactors, laying equipment, dumpers, material handlers and skips, plus
  accredited surfacing crews, foremen and site managers, on short or long-term hire.

## Sectors

[Sectors served](https://laurenceabbott.github.io/landm/sectors.html): highways,
industrial and commercial, construction, retail, education, sports and leisure, sea
ports, utilities, emergency services and healthcare, recycling and quarries,
residential, historical and conservation, and private clients.

## Case studies

- [Cringleford, Norwich, NR4](https://laurenceabbott.github.io/landm/case-study-cringleford.html)
  — resurfacing an adopted residential estate. 1,788 m² cold milled; 4,357 m² of
  SMA10 Surf 40/60 H/S machine laid at 40mm to the access roads; 1,585 m² of AC6
  Dense Surf 100/150 hand laid to footways; 120 m² of footway reconstructed in AC20
  binder at 50mm with AC6 surface course at 20mm; 218 m² of adopted driveways hand
  laid. 6,280 m² surfaced in total, delivered on time, in budget and to specification.
- [A14, Ipswich, IP1](https://laurenceabbott.github.io/landm/case-study-a14-ipswich.html)
  — labour supply. A chipping gang supplied to install pre-coated chips into hot
  rolled asphalt surface course, working overnight on a live trunk road under full
  traffic management, directly behind the machine gang laying the mat.
